extracted.intended_audience: military logisticians, Naval/MSC managers, procurement officers, and defense policy researchers
extracted.subtask_description: A master's thesis examining how OMB Circular A-76 procedures affect cost, operational readiness, and maintenance of Special Mission Ships in the Military Sealift Command (MSC) Nucleus Fleet, including discussion of PWS/SOW development, cost comparisons, QA, and appeals. Intended as an applied policy/management study for Navy/MSC audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect on cost of operations
rubrics_metrics.description: What is the effect of A-76 procedures on the cost of operations for the MSC Nucleus Fleet?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate via in-house vs contract cost comparisons, include cost estimates and examine drivers such as manning reductions; use DOD cost comparison handbook and MSC Management Efficiency Studies as sources of methodology and data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect on readiness and maintenance quality
rubrics_metrics.description: Will A-76 procedures affect readiness and maintenance quality of the MSC Nucleus Fleet?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess operational readiness indicators and maintenance outcomes pre- and post-A-76 implementation; consider whether cost savings come at the expense of maintenance quality or ship availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Problems encountered with A-76 application
rubrics_metrics.description: What problems have been encountered with the application of A-76 to the MSC Nucleus Fleet?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identify implementation obstacles (procedural, organizational, legal, contracting, manning), document case examples, and evaluate how these problems influenced outcomes and recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance work statement (PWS) control for service functions
rubrics_metrics.description: Performance work statement control for service functions needed by the government.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examine the clarity, completeness and control of PWS/SOW used to define commercial activities; reference OFPP pamphlet guidance for writing and administering performance statements of work and assess impacts on procurement/contract performance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of the Statement of Work / Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Development of the Statement (of Work) — procedures and content required under Circular A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include stepwise development processes, required elements, and examples; evaluate how well statements identify required services and measurable performance requirements to allow fair cost/quality comparisons between in-house and contractor offers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Circular A-76 decision and appeal procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Decision and appeal procedures under Circular A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document the prescribed decision-making steps, timelines, and appeal mechanisms; evaluate whether procedures protect fairness, allow challenge of results, and provide recourse for affected parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality assurance and Quality Assurance Initiatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality assurance initiatives and mechanisms to monitor performance of commercial activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess QA frameworks (e.g., QAO), inspection/acceptance criteria, and corrective action processes used to ensure contractors or in-house providers meet performance requirements; reference Navy QA initiatives and thesis-cited QA sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: In-house vs contract cost comparison methodology
rubrics_metrics.description: In-house vs contract commercial and industrial activities cost comparison (use of Handbook 4100.33-H and other guidance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow DOD and MSC cost-comparison handbooks for consistent methodology: identify direct/indirect costs, fringe benefits, overhead, and lifecycle costs; document assumptions, discounting, and sensitivity analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation status / progress toward full implementation
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of MSC progress toward full implementation of A-76 procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure implementation milestones, completion of required studies and competitions, manning changes, and organizational adjustments; use indicators such as completed competitions, documented cost savings, and updated policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation and use of cost estimates and competition preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation of cost estimates and activities related to preparing for A-76 competitions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document required preparatory steps: collection of baseline cost data, development of in-house performance plans, solicitation preparation, and government estimate development; evaluate completeness and realism of cost estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Policy and historical compliance with A-76 (conception and revision)
rubrics_metrics.description: Historical background and policy compliance: conception, development, revision and the Office of Federal Procurement/OMB policy context for A-76.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether local implementation aligns with the intent and revisions of Circular A-76 and related legislation (e.g., DoD Authorization Act), and whether policy guidance (OFPP pamphlets, OMB supplements) has been followed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measuring outcomes: cost savings vs service impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Balance measurement between reported cost savings and actual impacts on service delivery (manning reductions, operational performance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate reported savings claims by cross-checking with operational metrics (e.g., ship availability, maintenance backlog) and consider one-time vs recurring savings; examine whether savings are from productivity improvements or reductions in service levels.
